#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000000; // large value, n max maybe 2000, so n is safe.

int n, k;
vector<pair<int,int>> segs;
vector<int> l, delt;
vector<vector<int>> dp0, dp1;

struct RMQ {
    int n, K;
    vector<vector<int>> table;
    RMQ(const vector<int>& a) {
        n = a.size();
        K = 0;
        while ((1 << K) <= n) ++K;
        table.assign(K, vector<int>(n));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) table[0][i] = a[i];
        for (int i = 1; i < K; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j + (1 << (i-1)) < n; ++j) {
                table[i][j] = min(table[i-1][j], table[i-1][j + (1 << (i-1))]);
            }
        }
    }
    int getMin(int l, int r) const {
        int len = r - l + 1;
        int k = 0;
        while ((1 << (k+1)) <= len) ++k;
        return min(table[k][l], table[k][r - (1 << k) + 1]);
    }
};

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &k);
    segs.resize(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        scanf("%d%d", &segs[i].first, &segs[i].second);
    }
    sort(segs.begin(), segs.end(), [](const pair<int,int>& a, const pair<int,int>& b) {
        return a.first < b.first;
    });
    // merge overlapping intervals
    vector<pair<int,int>> merged;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ) {
        int lo = segs[i].first;
        int hi = segs[i].second;
        while (i < k && segs[i].first <= hi) {
            hi = max(hi, segs[i].second);
            ++i;
        }
        merged.push_back({lo, hi});
        // after while, i points to next unmerged interval
    }
    k = merged.size();
    segs = merged;
    l.resize(k);
    delt.resize(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        l[i] = segs[i].second - segs[i].first;
        if (i < k-1)
            delt[i] = segs[i+1].first - segs[i].second;
        else
            delt[i] = 2*n - segs[i].second;
    }
    int maxJ = 2*n;
    dp0.assign(k+1, vector<int>(maxJ+1, n));
    dp1.assign(k+1, vector<int>(maxJ+1, n));
    dp0[k][n] = 0;
    dp1[k][n] = 0;
    RMQ rmq0(dp0[k]), rmq1(dp1[k]);
    for (int i = k-1; i >= 0; --i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxJ; ++j) {
            // initial assignments
            if (j + l[i] + delt[i] <= maxJ)
                dp0[i][j] = dp0[i+1][j + l[i] + delt[i]];
            else
                dp0[i][j] = n;
            dp1[i][j] = dp1[i+1][j];
            // RMQ updates
            int r = min(j + l[i], maxJ);
            if (j <= r) {
                dp0[i][j] = min(dp0[i][j], 1 + rmq1.getMin(j, r));
                dp1[i][j] = min(dp1[i][j], 2 + rmq1.getMin(j, r));
            }
            if (j + delt[i] <= maxJ) {
                int r2 = min(j + l[i] + delt[i], maxJ);
                if (j + delt[i] <= r2) {
                    dp1[i][j] = min(dp1[i][j], 1 + rmq0.getMin(j + delt[i], r2));
                    dp0[i][j] = min(dp0[i][j], 2 + rmq0.getMin(j + delt[i], r2));
                }
            }
        }
        rmq0 = RMQ(dp0[i]);
        rmq1 = RMQ(dp1[i]);
    }
    int ans = dp1[0][0];
    if (ans == n) {
        printf("Hungry\n");
    } else {
        printf("Full\n%d\n", ans);
    }
    return 0;
}
